PowerBI_Toast_Subtitle_Cross_Filter_Limi: Clear your selection to try again.
PowerBI_Vega_Loader_Warning_HoverText: Remote resources cannot be loaded in the AppSource version.
PowerBI_Vega_Loader_Warning_DetailedText: Due to certification requirements, the AppSource version of Deneb does not permit loading from external URLs. This can be done with the standalone version, available from Deneb's GitHub repository. You can learn more about the standalone version on the Getting Started page on Deneb's website (https://deneb.guide/getting-started#standalone-version).
PowerBI_Viewer_Landing_Add_Data_Subtitle: Templates need at least one column or measure from your model.
PowerBI_Viewer_Landing_Add_Data_Body: Add the columns and measures you want to visualize to the Values data role. You'll assign them to the template's placeholders when you import it.
PowerBI_Viewer_Landing_Add_Data_Template: This visual has a template, but its Values data role is empty. Add the fields the template needs and it will display.
PowerBI_Viewer_Landing_Import_Body: Choose a template file, assign your fields to its placeholders, then create your visual.
PowerBI_Viewer_Landing_Experience_Body: Interact with it in your report as you would any other visual. Adjust tooltips, cross-filtering and rendering in the format pane. To use a different template, reset the Template card and import again.
PowerBI_Viewer_Landing_Link_Templates: Read about templates on the Deneb website
PowerBI_Viewer_Create_Overview: Import a template exported from Deneb, then assign your fields to its placeholders and create the visual.
PowerBI_Viewer_Template_Applied: Applied. Reset this card to remove it and its field mapping.
PowerBI_Viewer_Template_None: None. Import a template in the visual.
